newsitem.title: ITALY: FiatAuto '97 sales up 9.0 trln lire - Romiti.
newsitem.headline: FiatAuto '97 sales up 9.0 trln lire - Romiti.

text.p: Fiat Chairman Cesare Romiti said Fiat Auto, the group's car making division, was expected to show sales growth of 9.0 trillion lire in 1997.
Romiti, replying to questions at the group's shareholder meeting in Turin, said agriculture vehicle maker New Holland was expected to show 1997 sales growth of 1.5 trillion lire.

Romiti was asked where expected additional sales growth for the group this year was forecast to come from. He had earlier said group sales were expected to reach 90 trillion in 1997, which would be growth on 1996 of 12 trillion lire.
Truckmaker Iveco was expected to boost its sales 800 billlion lire this year, with the effect concentrated in the second half of the year, he said.
Other operations were forecast to give growth of 700 billion lire, he said.
The 9.0 trillion increase for Fiat Auto represented a 21 percent gain in sales and was forecast to come equally from Italy and abroad.
